ethics_check.title: Ethics Approval Check
ethics_check.summary_text: All papers that appeared to involve live data collection contained an ethics approval statement.

table.text: This study, which included functional tests in a human subject, was approved by the University of Pittsburgh Institutional Review Board (STUDY2007011) and Clinicaltrials.gov (NCT07056348).
All the recordings were carried out according to CARE guidelines and in compliance with the Declaration of Helsinki principles.
Additionally, participant provided written consent to the use of photos, videos, and voice-recorded acquired during the experiments for research purposes and publications.

Where needed, minimal manual corrections of the thalamic borders were applied with the WarpDrive tool, 64 using the whole-thalamus segmentation of the THOMAS atlas as the anatomical reference. 65 Individual thalamic nuclei were subsequently defined using the DISTAL atlas. 66 Electrode trajectories and contacts were automatically identified on postoperative CT using the PaCER algorithm. 67 Because directional leads were implanted, lead rotation was set manually in Lead-DBS according to the orientation estimates provided by the manufacturer's reconstruction.
table.formatted: Where needed, minimal manual corrections of the thalamic borders were applied with the WarpDrive tool, <ref type="bibr" target="#b58">64</ref> using the whole-thalamus segmentation of the THOMAS atlas as the anatomical reference. <ref type="bibr" target="#b59">65</ref> Individual thalamic nuclei were subsequently defined using the DISTAL atlas. <ref type="bibr" target="#b60">66</ref> Electrode trajectories and contacts were automatically identified on postoperative CT using the PaCER algorithm. <ref type="bibr" target="#b61">67</ref> Because directional leads were implanted, lead rotation was set manually in Lead-DBS according to the orientation estimates provided by the manufacturer's reconstruction.

table.text: Stimulation ON and OFF conditions were randomized across sessions.
Because the instructions provided to the subject were to clear the bolus in a single swallow, the area of residue was calculated after the first swallow.

ethics_check.report:
Based on the following text, we would expect an ethics approval statement, and it was present:

> Additionally, participant provided written consent to the use of photos, videos, and voice-recorded acquired during the experiments for research purposes and publications.

> Where needed, minimal manual corrections of the thalamic borders were applied with the WarpDrive tool, 64 using the whole-thalamus segmentation of the THOMAS atlas as the anatomical reference. 65 Individual thalamic nuclei were subsequently defined using the DISTAL atlas. 66 Electrode trajectories and contacts were automatically identified on postoperative CT using the PaCER algorithm. 67 Because directional leads were implanted, lead rotation was set manually in Lead-DBS according to the orientation estimates provided by the manufacturer's reconstruction.

> Stimulation ON and OFF conditions were randomized across sessions.

> Because the instructions provided to the subject were to clear the bolus in a single swallow, the area of residue was calculated after the first swallow.

Ethics approval statement:

> This study, which included functional tests in a human subject, was approved by the University of Pittsburgh Institutional Review Board (STUDY2007011) and Clinicaltrials.gov (NCT07056348).

> All the recordings were carried out according to CARE guidelines and in compliance with the Declaration of Helsinki principles.

power.title: Power Analysis Check
report:
::: {.callout-tip title="Learn More" collapse="true"}

Power analyses need to contain the following information to be interpretable: the type of power analysis, the statistical test, the software used, sample size, critical alpha criterion, power level, effect size, and an effect size metric. In addition, it is recommended to make sure the power analysis is reproducible (by sharing the code, or a screenshot, of the power analysis), and to provide good arguments for why the study was designed to detect an effect of this size.

For an a-priori power analysis, where the sample size is determined, reporting all information would look like:

> An a priori power analysis for an independent samples t-test, conducted using the pwr.t.test function from pwr (Champely, 2020), indicated that for a Cohen's d = 0.5, an alpha level of 0.05, and a desired power level of 80% required at least 64 participants in each group.

For a sensitivity power analysis, this sentence would look like:

> A sensitivity power analysis for an independent samples t-test, conducted using the pwr.t.test function from pwr (Champely, 2020), indicated that with 64 participants in each group, and an alpha level of 0.05, a desired power level of 80% was reached for an effect size of d = 0.5.

:::

table.formatted: We further assess the changes on swallowing efficiency by quantifying the duration of swallowing and the maximum amount of bolus spillage after the first swallow in the videofluoroscopic swallowing study. <ref type="bibr" target="#b4">10</ref> Dysphagia commonly results in delayed bolus transit and increased pharyngeal residue due to impaired strength and coordination of oropharyngeal musculature. <ref type="bibr" target="#b10">16</ref> Consistent with the clinical ratings, swallow duration was significantly shorter at year 3 than at year 1 (p=0.027, n = 4 tasks), indicating a faster, more efficient swallow (Figure <ref type="figure" target="#fig_2">3D</ref>).
table.header: Motor thalamus DBS improves oropharyngeal swallowing coordination and efficiency over time
table.expanded: We further assess the changes on swallowing efficiency by quantifying the duration of swallowing and the maximum amount of bolus spillage after the first swallow in the videofluoroscopic swallowing study. 10 Dysphagia commonly results in delayed bolus transit and increased pharyngeal residue due to impaired strength and coordination of oropharyngeal musculature. 16 Consistent with the clinical ratings, swallow duration was significantly shorter at year 3 than at year 1 (p=0.027, n = 4 tasks), indicating a faster, more efficient swallow (Figure 3D).

table.formatted: Indeed, it reduced pharyngeal bolus remnants (p = 0.037, n = 4 tasks; Figure <ref type="figure" target="#fig_2">3E-F</ref>), consistent with our previous report <ref type="bibr" target="#b4">10</ref>.
table.header: Motor thalamus DBS improves oropharyngeal swallowing coordination and efficiency over time
table.expanded: Indeed, it reduced pharyngeal bolus remnants (p = 0.037, n = 4 tasks; Figure 3E-F), consistent with our previous report 10.

report: Reporting *p* values imprecisely (e.g., *p* < .05) reduces transparency, reproducibility, and re-use (e.g., in *p* value meta-analyses). Best practice is to report exact p-values with three decimal places (e.g., *p* = .032) unless *p* values are smaller than 0.001, in which case you can use *p* < .001.

This module sometimes flags false positives when sentences discuss how p-value thresholds were set. It can also miss an imprecise p-value that is reported against a threshold (e.g., "decreased at the *p* < .05 significance threshold").

```{r}
#| echo: false


# table data --------------------------------------
table <- structure(list("P-Value" = c("p<0.05", "p<0.01", "p<0.05", "p<0.05", 
"p<0.01"), Text = c("Statistical significance was assessed with two-tail bootstrapping with Bonferroni correction: significance between DBS OFF and ON within the same sessions are indicated with p<0.05 (*), p<0.01 (**), p<0.001(***), significance across years for DBS OFF with p<0.05 ( + ), p<0.01 ( ++ ), p<0.001( +++ ), and significance across years for DBS ON with p<0.05 (*), p<0.01 (**), p<0.001(***).", 
"Statistical significance was assessed with two-tail bootstrapping with Bonferroni correction: significance between DBS OFF and ON within the same sessions are indicated with p<0.05 (*), p<0.01 (**), p<0.001(***), significance across years for DBS OFF with p<0.05 ( + ), p<0.01 ( ++ ), p<0.001( +++ ), and significance across years for DBS ON with p<0.05 (*), p<0.01 (**), p<0.001(***).", 
"Statistical significance for panels (d-e) was determined through matched one-way ANOVA, p<0.05 (*).", 
"Statistical significance was assessed with twotail bootstrapping with Bonferroni correction: significance between across years are indicated with p<0.05 (*), p<0.01 (**), p<0.001(***).", 
"Statistical significance was assessed with twotail bootstrapping with Bonferroni correction: significance between across years are indicated with p<0.05 (*), p<0.01 (**), p<0.001(***)."
)), row.names = c(NA, -5L), class = c("tbl_df", "tbl", "data.frame"
))

# display table -----------------------------------
metacheck::report_table(table, c(0.1, 0.9), 2, FALSE)
```

::: {.callout-tip title="Learn More" collapse="true"} The APA manual states: Report exact *p* values (e.g., *p* = .031) to two or three decimal places. However, report *p* values less than .001 as *p* < .001. However, 2 decimals is too imprecise for many use-cases (e.g., a *p* value meta-analysis), so report *p* values with three digits. live_data_statements: Additionally, participant provided written consent to the use of photos, videos, and voice-recorded acquired during the experiments for research purposes and publications.

Where needed, minimal manual corrections of the thalamic borders were applied with the WarpDrive tool, 64 using the whole-thalamus segmentation of the THOMAS atlas as the anatomical reference. 65 Individual thalamic nuclei were subsequently defined using the DISTAL atlas. 66 Electrode trajectories and contacts were automatically identified on postoperative CT using the PaCER algorithm. 67 Because directional leads were implanted, lead rotation was set manually in Lead-DBS according to the orientation estimates provided by the manufacturer's reconstruction.
Stimulation ON and OFF conditions were randomized across sessions.
Because the instructions provided to the subject were to clear the bolus in a single swallow, the area of residue was calculated after the first swallow.
